title: Gingerbread Waffles
hookLine: Global-inspired gingerbread waffles with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: beat egg and sugar into a light foam. Keep {m53578_1}, {m53578_2}, {m53578_3}, and {m53578_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: sift together flour, salt and gingerbread spice. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even. Incorporate {m53578_5}, {m53578_6}, {m53578_7}, and {m53578_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture gradually while stirring. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Add milk and beer while stirring. Combine until completely smooth, uniform, and free of lumps before moving to the next stage.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Garnish & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Let set and bake waffles. Drain briefly on a wire cooling rack lined with paper towels for 1–2 minutes so the outside stays shatteringly crisp, then plate into 4 servings and enjoy warm.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
